name: Atlas
source:
His cold gaze and unfriendly attitude makes Atlas someone hard to approach. The only one who is able to make him lose his temper is Cronus, which happens often.

Atlas has a strong sense of duty and will stop at nothing to achieve his goals.

"You should start getting used to the rough treatment."
